donors.description: Stores institutional and volunteer blood donor profiles with clinical metadata
donors.documentId: registerNumber (e.g., student/faculty ID) or email to prevent duplicates

year.description: Current academic year or employment status

blood_group.description: Blood type group. Supported values: A+, A-, B+, B-, AB+, AB-, O+, O-

mobileNumber.description: Verified mobile phone number with optional country code

location.description: Primary area or campus of residency/availability

weight.description: Donor weight in kilograms. Mandatory safety check (>= 50kg for clinical safety)

last_donation_date.description: ISO-8601 formatted date of the most recent donation, or empty string if never donated

userType.description: Sub-classification of the ecosystem user account

availability.description: Direct indicator of real-time contact availability status

totalDonations.description: Lifetime total of completed blood donations

gender.description: Biological sex. Governs recovery cool-down interval rules (Male: 90 days, Female: 120 days)

dob.description: ISO-8601 date of birth. Governs minimum age threshold (>= 18 years)

profilePhoto.description: URL to profile photo in Firebase Cloud Storage

updated_at.description: Automatic ServerTimestamp of last change update

donation_history.description: Tracks verified historical donations by this donor

verified_at.description: Verification date-time stamp by institutional admin

indexes.description: Required composite index to perform fast filtering on compatible and currently available donors.
